question: A proton moves with a velocity of 3 × 10⁶ m/s perpendicular to a magnetic field of 0.5 T. What is the radius of the circular path followed by the proton? (mass of proton = 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, charge of proton = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C)

options: A. 15 cm on the same side as the object
B. 15 cm on the opposite side of the object
C. 30 cm on the opposite side of the object

question: A gas at a pressure of 2 × 10⁵ Pa occupies a volume of 3 m³ at a temperature of 300 K. What volume will the gas occupy if the pressure is increased to 6 × 10⁵ Pa and the temperature raised to 450 K?

options: A. Wavelength is directly proportional to momentum

D. Wavelength is independent of momentum
